educatorResources.name: Mythical Void STEM Creature Lab
educatorResources.description: A free four-page activity that starts with a real NASA clue, separates science from fiction, and invites young designers to invent and test an organism from another dimension.
educatorResources.disclosure: Independent Mythical Void activity. NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

sharingResources.name: Mythical Void play-and-share card
sharingResources.audience: Adults, families, educators, clubs and events
sharingResources.description: A free one-page A4 card with a clean QR link to the playable browser game, one real gameplay frame and clearly disclosed creature-universe artwork.
sharingResources.disclosure: The large creature-universe image is an AI-generated marketing illustration, not gameplay. The framed Project Beacon image is real gameplay. NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

permissions: Assets may be used in truthful editorial coverage of Mythical Void with their descriptions and disclosures preserved.
restrictions: Only assets labelled authentic_running_build_screenshot may be described as gameplay screenshots.
Only assets labelled authentic_running_build_gameplay_video may be described as gameplay footage.
Branded social videos contain authentic gameplay but must be described as edited layouts rather than raw gameplay footage.
Do not present marketing illustrations or game-world artwork as gameplay footage.
Do not imply NASA endorsement or partnership.
Do not imply sentience, consciousness, global creature uniqueness or a fully autonomous studio.
